essence: Make good choices automatic and bad ones impossible.
modern_lens: Chapter 14 shows how a single decision now can shape behaviour for months: an automatic transfer, a recurring calendar block, a password your partner keeps. Commitment devices and automation move the choice to a moment when you are thinking clearly, so your future self does not need willpower.

ideas.name: Commitment Devices
ideas.text: A commitment device is a choice you make now that controls your actions later: buying snacks in single portions, booking a class with a cancellation fee, setting the router to switch off at 11pm. It turns a good intention into a constraint.
ideas.try: Choose one commitment device for your hardest habit and set it up today.

ideas.name: One-Time Choices
ideas.text: Some decisions pay off again and again after you make them once: automatic savings, unsubscribing from marketing emails, a better mattress, automatic pension contributions. Look for these single actions with long-lasting effects.
ideas.try: List five one-time choices that would improve your habits, and do one this week.

ideas.name: Let Technology Do It
ideas.text: Automation can make good habits happen without you: scheduled reports, recurring calendar blocks, bill autopay, app time limits. The more a behaviour runs on its own, the less it depends on memory and mood. Remember that technology automates bad habits too.
ideas.try: Automate one recurring good action, such as a transfer, a reminder or a report.

ideas.name: Make Bad Habits Impossible
ideas.text: The strongest form of the inverted third law is to remove the option altogether: a timed lock box for the phone, blocked websites during work hours, no card saved on shopping sites. Impossible is easier than hard.
ideas.try: Pick one bad habit and remove the option to do it during your most vulnerable hours.

ideas.name: Bind Your Future Self
ideas.text: Like the sailor in the old myth who had himself tied to the mast before sailing past the sirens, you can lock in a decision before temptation arrives. Make the choice while you are calm, so it holds when you are not.
ideas.try: Write down one decision you will make in advance for next week's most tempting moment.
